architecture.mechanism: Integrating multiple smaller units aggregates their contributions, producing greater power/capacity than any single unit alone.
architecture.intervention: Reconfigure the drill battery pack so multiple smaller lithium-ion cells are paralleled within the existing form factor, sharing heavy-load current across cells instead of stressing a single series string, and add cell balancing to manage cell-to-cell heterogeneity.
architecture.expected_effect: Lower per-cell current and heat under heavy load, reducing rapid capacity fade and sustaining power through a full shift without swapping packs.
architecture.falsification_test: Build two packs of identical total rated capacity and form factor, one baseline single-series-string and one with parallel cell banks, run an identical heavy-load duty cycle (continuous high-torque drilling at rated current) while logging discharge curves, per-cell temperature, and capacity fade over N cycles; if the parallelized pack shows no statistically significant reduction in temperature rise or capacity fade versus baseline, the mechanism is falsified.

challenge.kill_reason: all deterministic checks passed; the adversarial gauntlet's objections are ESCALATED (uncalibrated attacker, Art. L) and ride the record for adjudication
